utfall: metodegjennomgang av makroeffekter av forlengelser: studier av uventede kutt gir en nedre grense for effekten
sitat: We find more promising the approach based on unexpected policy changes as in the recent contributions by Johnston and Mas (2015) and Hagedorn, Manovskii and Mitman (2015). This approach by design addresses the problem of benefit endogeneity. It does not, however, fully address the effects of expectations and generally yields a lower bound on the actual effects of policies.

utfall: avgang fra ledighet etter kutt på 16 uker i Missouri: svært stor positiv effekt (gjengitt fra Johnston og Mas 2015)
sitat: Using individual-level administrative data on unemployment and employment, the authors find a very large positive effect of the cut in benefit duration on exit rate from unemployment (mainly into employment).
